title: Deeper/broader current FreeCAD importer contract and layout limit
mode: Primary-source web research and plan reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Reconcile earlier archived-documentation claims against the current FreeCAD documentation repository.
Separate DWG conversion, DXF importer/backend, explicit 3D entity, ACIS solid, and paper-space layout evidence.
Refine the existing FreeCAD consumer qualification and PAR-49 readiness without adding per-slice runtime requirements.

sources.revision: Mutable main pages accessed 2026-10-20; no commit/release or application runtime pinned
sources.observed: Current documentation describes DWG-to-DXF conversion followed by a selected DXF importer, names LibreDWG/ODA/QCAD converter choices, distinguishes C++ and legacy Python importer feature lists, lists 3DFACE on the legacy list but not the C++ list, and says stock FreeCAD cannot read DXF ACIS/SAT blobs. The GitHub organization describes FreeCAD-Doc as former synced online documentation, distinct from the currently accessible FreeCAD-documentation repository.
sources.limits: Documentation is not proof of a particular installed FreeCAD build, converter, preference state, importer backend, or runtime behavior. No native app was run.

sources.revision: Mutable main source accessed 2026-10-20; no commit or runtime pinned
sources.observed: The adapter describes the DWG layer as conversion to/from DXF and delegates actual parsing to importDXF. Its current source contains converter branches for LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD, so the selected route must be captured from the running configuration.
sources.limits: Source inspection is not a successful conversion/import result and does not qualify intermediate fidelity or consumer object semantics.

sources.project: FreeCAD C++ DXF importer multi-layout issue
sources.revision: Issue page accessed 2026-10-20; report describes FreeCAD 1.0.1 / 1.1.0dev on Windows; no current build reproduced
sources.observed: The issue is marked confirmed and reports that the C++ DXF importer imports only one paper-space layout when the layout option is enabled. The report has no linked fix on the reviewed issue page.
sources.limits: A downstream issue report is not a current reproduced result, format rule, or libdxfrw codec defect.

sources.project: FreeCAD ACIS import limitation and current C++ importer source
sources.revision: Issue and mutable main source accessed 2026-10-20; no runtime or independent kernel comparison performed
sources.observed: A FreeCAD maintainer says explicit DXF entities can import while opaque proprietary ACIS blobs cannot be interpreted by stock FreeCAD. The C++ importer constructs application shapes from parsed geometry callbacks.
sources.limits: This neither establishes ACIS semantic support nor independently validates a libdxfrw parser, DWG AcDs association, or OCCT-based geometry result.

existingSubplansRefined: Consumer qualification: name converter, intermediate DXF, selected importer backend/settings, and per-object outcomes
PAR-49: do not use FreeCAD C++ multi-layout import as sole writer/layout oracle
3D support: separate explicit 3D entities from opaque ACIS/AcDs solid semantics

planChanges: Added a current-source reconciliation: earlier statements that the FreeCAD-documentation repository itself is archived are superseded; the former FreeCAD-Doc repository is distinct.
Made the FreeCAD DWG route explicit as converter to intermediate DXF to selected importer/backend, with the C++ and legacy Python importer capability lists kept separate.
Added a confirmed downstream C++ importer multi-layout limitation as a consumer-only caution; codec writer layout validation remains based on emitted structure and independent readers.
Separated explicit 3D entities such as 3DFACE from ACIS/SAT solid blobs and from DWG AcDs association/modeler semantics.
Kept native tests at the composed checkpoint, local fast tests as per-slice validation, and all unavailable external checks non-blocking.
limitations: All FreeCAD source and documentation links are mutable main-branch pages and were not pinned to immutable commits in this pass.
Issue #22214 reports specific historical builds; no Linux or Windows runtime was executed to establish current status.
No DXF/DWG sample was downloaded, no external fixture was added, and no FreeCAD application or converter was run.
